paper: A Prompt Framework for Expert-Free LLM-Based Fully Automated Simple Power Analysis on Cryptosystems
cohort: Reported 500 LLM runs: 250 per model, ten reported runs per trace
settings: Actual temperature and tool-call limits are recorded separately for each run.
selection_notes: The GPT-4o ASIC entry averages seven full recoveries and the three highest-accuracy failures among 22 runs.
operation_labels: D is the majority operation/bit 0; A is the minority operation/bit 1. RSA S/M and Kyber bits map to D/A for scoring.
curves: Intermediate scores may be reconstructed by offline replay; archived final snapshots take precedence at termination.
